Tuan Chi-jui
Succumbs At
Age Of 72

Aged Former Head Of
Government Dies At
Ave. Joffe Home

SIGNED CHINA
INTO WORLD WAR

Long, Notable Career
In Politics Ended For
Anfu Clique Leader

Marshal Tuan Chi-jui, aged
Chinese statesman, died at his
private residence on Avenue Joffre
at 9 p.m. last night. Death was
caused by digestive trouble, from
which he had been suffering for a
number of years.
Born at Hofei, Anhwei, in 1864,
Marshal Tuan was graduated from
the Peiyang
Military Academy at Tien-
tsin in 1885. He
later went to
Germany to
study artillery
science, and
upon his return
to China, he
joined Yuan
Shih-kai in the
training of a
modern army
for China, and
subsequently became one of the most prominent figures in Chinese politics.

When he again became Prime
Minister and Minister of War in
1918, he organized the powerful
Anfu clique, of which he was also
the leader. He is also well remem-
bered for his suppression of the
abortive attempt of General Chang
Tsun-chang to restore the Manchu
monarchy in 1917. In the following
year he assumed the post of Dir-
ector-General of the Frontier De-
fence Bureau. From November,
1924 until he retired from active
political life in 1926, he was the
Provisional Chief Executive of
China.
Last year when rumors were rife
connecting his name with a plot
to form an autonomous government
in North China under the protection
of the Japanese, he voluntarily
moved to Shanghai in spite of the
fact that he was in fragile health.
This move succeeded in dispelling
all rumors, and he was highly laud-
ed by the people throughout the
country for his patriotism. His
death is undoubtedly a great loss
to the country and will be mourned
by all his countrymen who have
come to love and respect him.

段祺瑞
享年72岁逝世

前政府首脑于霞飞路寓所去世

曾签署中国参加世界大战

安福系领袖漫长而显赫的政治生涯终结

中国老政治家段祺瑞元帅于昨晚9时在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）其私宅逝世。死因为消化系统疾病，他受此病困扰已多年。

段元帅1864年生于安徽合肥，1885年毕业于天津北洋武备学堂。后赴德国研习炮兵科学，归国后加入袁世凯麾下，参与训练中国新式陆军，随后成为中国政坛最显赫的人物之一。

1918年，他再次出任国务总理兼陆军总长时，组织了势力强大的安福系，并担任该派系首领。他还因镇压了1917年张勋将军复辟满清帝制的未遂企图而广为人知。次年，他出任边防督办。从1924年11月起直至1926年退出活跃的政治生活，他一直担任中华民国临时执政。

去年，当谣言四起，称其名字与在日本庇护下于华北组建自治政府的阴谋有关时，尽管身体虚弱，他仍自愿移居上海。此举成功消除了所有谣言，其爱国精神受到全国民众的高度赞扬。他的逝世无疑是国家的一大损失，所有爱戴和尊敬他的同胞都将为之哀悼。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL REPORT
S. B. REGISTRY
Louza Station,
Date 10 / 1 / 33

Subject (in full) Sino-Japanese Situation in Manchuria.

Made by and Forwarded by C. D. I. Robertson.

（批：P.O.A Information）
（批：B.C. main Information A.J. 171 B）

During a conversation with the Secretary to a Government Official on January 9, in connection with a criminal investigation he expressed the following opinion which is forwarded herewith as a matter of intelligence;

"At the outset of Sino-Japanese hostilities in Manchuria in September 1931 the National Government made a great mistake in not opening direct negotiations with Japan for a settlement of the dispute. At that time we were handicapped by public opinion being against direct negotiation and were content to leave the matter in the hands of the League of Nations, but the League is of necessity a slow moving Body which we fear can be of little assistance to China in the present crisis. We also realise that the present depression in Europe and America will not permit any of the Powers, with the exception of France whom we suspect of being in sympathy with the Japanese, to intervene on our behalf. The National Government fully expects the Japanese to occupy Peking and Tientsin and to install Mr. Henry Pu Yi as Emperor of Northern China. This would mean the return of a Chinese Monarchy under Japanese control which might easily envelope the whole of China. In order to offset this, the National Government will favour direct negotiation with Japan as a means to the Settlement of the dispute which of course will mean that the Japanese will get all they want in Manchuria. We doubt very much, however, if they will listen to us. We are further handicapped by the attitude of certain leaders especially Chang Hsueh Liang. In spite of repeated requests he is afraid to do anything and for some time past has secretly favoured the idea of direct negotiation with

主题（全称） 满洲的中日局势。

制作及呈报人：C. D. I. Robertson。

（批：P.O.A 情报）
（批：B.C. 主要情报 A.J. 171 B）

1月9日，在与一名政府官员的秘书就一起刑事调查进行谈话时，他表达了以下观点，现作为情报事项转发如下：

“1931年9月满洲中日敌对行动开始时，国民政府未与日本直接谈判以解决争端，犯下了重大错误。当时我们受制于公众舆论反对直接谈判，满足于将此事交由国际联盟处理，但国联必然是一个行动缓慢的机构，我们担心它在当前危机中对中国助益甚微。我们也意识到，欧美目前的经济萧条使得除法国（我们怀疑其同情日本）以外的任何列强都不会代表我们进行干预。国民政府完全预料到日本将占领北平和天津，并扶植溥仪先生出任华北皇帝。这意味着在中国控制下恢复君主制，这可能轻易笼罩整个中国。为了抵消这一点，国民政府将赞成与日本直接谈判，作为解决争端的手段，这当然意味着日本将获得其在满洲想要的一切。然而，我们非常怀疑他们是否会听从我们的意见。我们还受到某些领导人态度的掣肘，特别是张学良。尽管反复请求，他不敢采取任何行动，并且在过去一段时间里一直暗中倾向于将直接与

（印：首席督察长办公室 1933年1月10日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）
（批：C.P.）
（批：Shirley 1933年1月10日）

January 7, 1933. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

THE SHANHAIKWAN INCIDENT.

Interviewed yesterday by local pressmen,
T.V. Soong, Acting President of the Executive Council,
released the following statement:-
"The Government is paying close attention
to the grave situation caused by the attack on China.
No emergency meeting has been convoked to discuss the affair
as it is not necessary at present. The Nationalist Armies
and the Government Departments concerned have already been
instructed to deal with all untoward incidents. Great
events are ahead and all the people throughout the country
must undertake the salvation of the nation."

General Wu Te-chen, Mayor of the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai, yesterday expressed himself as follows
to a reporter of the Central News Agency:-
"I have just received a telegram from Peiping
stating that the Chinese and Japanese forces are facing each
other along the south-west sector of Shanhaikwan. Minor
clashes have frequently occurred, but there has been no
serious fighting during the last twenty-four hours. There
are many Japanese warships at Chingwangtao and the situation
is very tense. I regret the loss of Shanhaikwan; it was
due to China's restraint owing to the treaties."

The Chamber of Commerce sent the following
telegram to Marshal Chang Hsueh-liang yesterday:-
"We admire the resistance offered by the
Chinese soldiers to the enemy at Shanhaikwan and Chingwangtao.
We hope you will issue strict instructions to the officers
and men of the army to guard the territory and to continue
their resistance."

On January 6, the Chamber of Commerce dispatched
a telegram to the National Government, urging it to hasten
the departure of Dr. Alfred Sze, the newly appointed Chinese
Minister to the United States.

The Sin Wan Pao publishes the following
telegram from Nanking:-
General Tsai Ting Kai, Commander of the 19th
Route Army, has sent a telegram to Canton proposing that
10,000 men be selected from his army to be sent to the North.

and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs:-

We hereby ask you to declare a severance of relations with

杂项

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

山海关事件。

行政院代院长宋子文（T.V. Soong）昨日接受本地记者采访，发表如下声明：
“政府正密切关注因袭击中国而引起的严峻局势。目前无需召开紧急会议讨论此事，故未召集。国民革命军及相关政府部门已奉命处理所有意外事件。大事在即，全国民众必须承担起救国的责任。”

大上海市市长吴铁城将军昨日向中央通讯社记者表示：
“我刚收到北平来电，称中日军队在山海关西南段对峙。小规模冲突频繁发生，但在过去二十四小时内未发生严重战斗。秦皇岛有许多日本军舰，局势非常紧张。我对山海关失守感到遗憾；这是由于中国受条约约束而保持克制所致。”

商会昨日向张学良元帅发出如下电报：
“我们钦佩中国士兵在山海关和秦皇岛对敌人进行的抵抗。希望您向全军官兵发布严令，守卫国土并继续抵抗。”

1月6日，商会致电国民政府，敦促其加快新任驻美公使施肇基博士（Dr. Alfred Sze）的启程。

《新闻报》刊登如下来自南京的电报：
第十九路军总指挥蔡廷锴将军已致电广州，提议从其部队中挑选一万人北上。

关于山海关事件的插曲。各团体救国联合会和东北义勇军后援会向南京政府、行政院和外交部发出如下联合电报：
“山海关现已失守，入侵者即将进入我国领土。我们不应再犹豫。特此要求你们宣布与

MISCELLANEOUS

Japan and to demand that the League of Nations apply Article
16 of the League Covenant in order to check the atrocities
of Japan. You must be prompt in making up your mind in
this matter because the very existence of our land
depends on it."

The two organizations also sent the following
telegram to General Chiang Kai-shek, Marshal Chang Hsueh-
liang and various military leaders:
"Shanhaikwan is lost. What do you mean
by guarding your territory in this manner? Your responsibil
can never be shifted. You should not hesitate any more.
You should at once rush all your forces to defend the
country. We, the people throughout the country, swear
to support you."

The General Labour Union has sent the following
urgent telegram to Marshal Chang Hsueh-liang:-
"The atrocious Japanese have now invaded
Shanhaikwan. General Ho Chu-kuo put up a brave resistance,
but was overwhelmed. A stronghold of the north has now
been lost and Peiping and Tientsin are faced with eminent
danger. We have shed tears of blood. The barbarous
Japanese are making preparations to seize Chingwangtao and
Peiping. We sincerely hope you will raise your armies to
recover Shanhaikwan and the north-east.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

MEMORIAL SERVICE FOR SON OF CHEN CHI-MEI.

A memorial service will be held in the premises
of the Wu Zay, Kwaichow Road, at 2 p.m. January 8 in honour
of Chen Sen Fu (the eldest son of the late Chen Chi Mei).
Chen Sen Fu was killed at Hangchow on
September 9 last through an aeroplane accident.

Min Pao publishes the following telegram from Nanking:

CHIANG KAI-SHEK RETURNS TO THE CAPITAL.

General Chiang Kai-shek returned to Nanking
from Hangchow on January 6.

杂项

日本断绝关系，并要求国际联盟应用《国联盟约》第十六条，以制止日本的暴行。在此事上你们必须迅速决断，因为我们国土的存亡系于此。”

这两个组织还向蒋介石将军、张学良元帅及各军事领导人发出如下电报：
“山海关失守。你们这样守卫国土是什么意思？你们的责任永远无法推卸。你们不应再犹豫。应立即调动全部兵力保卫国家。我们，全国民众，发誓支持你们。”

总工会向张学良元帅发出如下急电：
“残暴的日本人现已入侵山海关。何柱国将军进行了英勇抵抗，但被压倒。北方重镇现已失守，北平和天津面临迫在眉睫的危险。我们泣血痛心。野蛮的日本人正准备夺取秦皇岛和北平。我们真诚希望您率军收复山海关和东北。”

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

陈其美之子追悼会。

1月8日下午2时，将在贵州路伍宅举行追悼会，以纪念陈其美先生长子陈森夫。陈森夫于去年9月9日在杭州因飞机事故遇难。

《民报》刊登如下来自南京的电报：

蒋介石返回首都。

蒋介石将军于1月6日从杭州返回南京。

Political

Movement of Notables
To Peking
Departed at 11.40 p.m. January 4:-
Kwok Tseng-kiang (郭曾江), Yu Mai-kwang (于乃光),
Teng Loh-ying (王六寅), Tsou Che-kiang (周哲江)
and Tsou Muh-hai (周佛海), all members of the
C.E.C. of Kuomintang.
Departed at 9.25 a.m. January 5 :-
Koo Meng-yu, Minister of Railways.

Local Kuomintang Meeting
Eight members of the local Kuomintang Headquarters
held an important meeting in their office, Lim: Ying
Road, West Gate, between 10.30 and 11.45 a.m. January 4
and discussed the Japanese invasion of Jehol. The
following resolutions were passed :
1. That the Central Kuomintang be requested to instruct
the National Government to devise measures at once
to deal with the critical situation in Jehol and
mobilise the army to reinforce the garrison there
in order to defend Tientsin and Peking.
2. That Marshal Chang Hsueh-liang be urged by telegram
to resist the Japanese aggression and recover the lost
territory in the North East.
3. That the Central Kuomintang be requested to impeach
Chang Hsueh-liang and Ting Wen-chiang as well as other
responsible military officers for their failure to
defend Chinese territory in the North East.

本地国民党会议
1月4日上午10时30分至11时45分，国民党本地总部八名成员在西门林荫路（Lim: Ying Road）办公室举行重要会议，讨论日本入侵热河问题。通过以下决议：

Jan. 3, 1933.

Commissioner of Police,

It is reported that General
Chiang Kai-shek held a conference with local
Chinese officials today when the subject of possible
reaction locally of the latest move on the part of
the Japanese forces at Shanhaikwan was discussed.
Exactly what transpired is not known but it is
learned that those attending considered the
situation grave and one for anxiety. The Japanese
naval review at Hongkew park tomorrow was cited
as a possible instance from which trouble might
arise.

From the same source it is
also reported that General Chiang departed for
Hangchow at the conclusion of the conference.

Min Pao dated January 27:

THE CALLER ON MARSHAL TUAN CHI-JUI.

Owing to the cold weather, Tuan Chi-jui has
decided to spend a few days in Shanghai. On the afternoon
of January 25, Tuan called on Tsang Tai-yien (章太炎)
in Dong Foh Li off Yates Road. On January 26, General
Chang Chun visited him.

China Evening News dated January 27:

Tuan Chi-jui was entertained a dinner in the
auditorium of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce
at noon on January 27. Chinese and foreign detectives
and policemen were posted in the vicinity of the Temple
of Queen of Heaven.
Over 80 persons representing 18 public bodies,
including the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce, the
Chinese Ratepayers Associations of the International
Settlement and the French Concession, the Shanghai Bar
Association, the Shanghai General Labour Union, the
Shanghai Accountants Association, the Chinese Citizens
Anti-Opium Association, etc. were present.

拜访段祺瑞元帅者。

因天气寒冷，段祺瑞决定在上海逗留数日。1月25日下午，段在亚尔培路（Yates Road）东佛里拜访了章太炎。1月26日，张群将军拜访了他。

1月27日《China Evening News》：

1月27日中午，段祺瑞在上海总商会礼堂出席晚宴。中外侦探和警察在天后宫附近布防。
包括上海总商会、公共租界和法租界华人纳税会、上海律师公会、上海总工会、上海会计师公会、中国国民拒毒会等在内的18个公共团体的80多名代表出席了会议。

January 25, 1933. Afternoon Translation

POLITICAL

China Times and other local newspapers

ARRIVAL OF TUAN CHI JUI IN SHANGHAI.

4H382
Tuan Chi Jui arrived at Shanghai from Nanking by rail at 8 a.m. yesterday. Among those at the Shanghai North Station to welcome the Marshal were Mayor Wu Te Chen, General Yang Fu, General Wen Hung En, Messrs. Yu Yeh Ching, Wong Shao Len, Doo Yuet Sen, Tsang Shao Ling and representatives of various public bodies. After his arrival the Marshal, in company with Wu Kwang Sin and Hsu Shu Ying, took motor car No.7683 and proceeded to the World Club, No. 393 Route Fergusson.

Marshal Tuan has declined all invitations by local public bodies.

In the afternoon Mr. Sun Fo, General Tai Chi and others called on the Marshal.

In an interview with a number of local journalists, the Marshal said: "I have come to the South simply to visit my sister at Nanking and my daughter at Shanghai. I am on the present trip at the invitation of General Chiang Kai Shek. I am an ordinary citizen and I do not know whether my views I have expressed are suitable or not. With regard to the situation in North China, the crisis can not be averted unless China exerts herself for her own salvation. The action of Japan has reached a stage at which she cannot be moved by feeling or by considerations of justice. On the other hand, it is a great lesson to China. We should not lose any time in coming to our senses. To-day's failure is due to lack of preparations during the past 40 years. Let us look at Russia. She has attained a strong position through co-operation between the people and the government. The time is not too late to redress the wrong if China will wake up early".

At noon the Marshal attended a tiffin party given in his honour by Mayor Wu Te Chen. In the evening Mr. Sun Fo, President of the Legislative Yuan, entertained the Marshal to a dinner party which was attended by Mayor Wu Te Chen, Dr. C.T.Wang, Dr. T.V.Soong, General Chang Chun, Messrs. Yu Yeh Ching, Doo Yuet Sen, Tsang Shao Len, Hsieh Tso Pei, So Xiang Kai and others.

1933年1月25日。下午译文

政治

《时报》及其他本地报纸

段祺瑞抵达上海。

4H382
段祺瑞于昨日早上8点乘火车从南京抵达上海。前往上海北站欢迎元帅的有市长吴铁城、杨虎将军、温应星将军、虞洽卿、黄绍兰、杜月笙、张啸林先生及各公共团体代表。抵达后，元帅与吴光新、徐树英一同乘坐7683号汽车，前往费格斯路393号世界社。

段元帅已谢绝本地各公共团体的所有邀请。

下午，孙科先生、戴季陶将军等人拜访了元帅。

元帅在接受本地记者采访时说：“我此次南下，仅仅是为了探望在南京的姐姐和在上海的女儿。我此次行程是应蒋介石将军之邀。我是一介平民，不知我所表达的观点是否恰当。关于华北局势，除非中国努力自救，否则危机无法避免。日本的行动已达到不为情感或正义考量所动的地步。另一方面，这对中国是一个巨大的教训。我们不应浪费时间，应尽快醒悟。今日的失败是由于过去40年缺乏准备所致。看看俄国。她通过人民与政府的合作获得了强大的地位。如果中国能早日觉醒，纠正错误为时未晚。”

中午，元帅出席了市长吴铁城为其举行的午宴。晚上，立法院院长孙科宴请元帅，出席晚宴的有市长吴铁城、王正廷博士、宋子文博士、张群将军、虞洽卿、杜月笙、张啸林、谢作裴、索相凯等先生。

January 24, 1933.
Morning Translation.

POLITICAL.

Shun Peo:

TUAN CHI JUI DUE IN SHANGHAI TO-DAY.

According to Chien Hsin Tze, the former
Chinese Ambassador to France, it was General Chiang Kai
Shek who had asked him to invite Tuan Chi Jui to proceed
to the South for a conference on the national crisis.
Tuan arrived at Nanking on January 20. At January 23
at 3 p.m. January 23, he visited Sun Yet-sen's Tomb with
General Chiang Kai Shek. After the visit, he took a
train to Shanghai and is due to arrive here this morning.
Tuan will remain here a few days, after
which he will make a trip to Pootoo and Hangchow and
then to Tsingtao. General Chiang has telegraphed
Mayor Yu Te-chen to welcome Tuan. General Chang Chun,
Hsu Sze Ming, Yu Kwang Hsin, Wei Chung Man and Fei Kai
Yung are accompanying Tuan to Shanghai.
Mayor Yu has arranged a temporary residence
for Tuan and his suite in the World Academy, 393 Rue
Ferguson.

A welcome meeting has been prepared by the
Chamber of Commerce, the District Mutual Aid Association,
the China Aviation Federation, the North Eastern Refugees
Relief Association, the Civil War Abolition League, the
Volunteers Support Association and All-Chekiang
Association. These bodies will detail representatives to
welcome Tuan at the Station.
Mayor Yu will give a dinner to Tuan in the
World Academy at noon to-day while Sun Fo will invite
Tuan to a banquet at his resident 22 Columbia Road to-
night.

MISCELLANEOUS

China Times and other local newspapers

REASSESSMENT OF RENTALS : PROTEST BY 2 TEASHOPS.

The Chinese Ratepayers Association of the
International Settlement yesterday sent the following
letter to the Shanghai Municipal Council:-
"This Association is in receipt of the following
letter from the First District Branch of the Shanghai
Citizens Federation:-
'We have received a letter from the Yih
Loh Tien (......) Teashop, 513 Nanking Road, and the
Toong Yui Tshung (......) Teashop, 465 Nanking Road,
stating that a notice as received on December 23,
1932, to the effect that as from April 1, 1933, the
annual municipal rate to be paid by the Yih Loh Tien
Teashop will be based on a rental of $9240 instead of
$4,000 and that the rate of the Toong Yui Tshung Tea-
shop will be based on a rental of $6,240 instead of
$4,400.'

1933年1月24日。
晨间译文。

政治。

《申报》：

段祺瑞今日抵沪。

据前驻法公使钱辛耔称，是蒋介石将军请他邀请段祺瑞南下商讨国家危机。段于1月20日抵达南京。1月23日下午3时，他与蒋介石将军一同谒陵（孙中山墓）。谒陵后，他乘火车前往上海，预计将于今晨抵达。
段将在此停留数日，随后将前往普陀和杭州，然后去青岛。蒋介石已电告市长吴铁城欢迎段。张群、徐世明、俞广信、魏仲曼和费凯庸陪同段前往上海。

吴市长已在费格斯路393号世界学院为段及其随员安排了临时住所。

总商会、区互助会、中国航空协会、东北难民救济协会、废止内战大同盟、志愿者支援协会和全浙公会已准备了欢迎会议。这些团体将派遣代表到车站欢迎段。
吴市长将于今日中午在世界学院设宴招待段，而孙科将于今晚在其哥伦比亚路22号的寓所邀请段参加宴会。

杂项

《时报》及其他本地报纸

重估租金：两家茶馆抗议。

公共租界华人纳税会昨日致函上海工部局如下：-
“本会收到上海市民联合会第一区分会来函：-
‘我方收到南京路513号益乐天（......）茶馆和南京路465号同裕春（......）茶馆来信，称其于1932年12月23日收到通知，内容大致为：自1933年4月1日起，益乐天茶馆每年应缴的市政捐税将以9240美元的租金为基础计算，而非4000美元；同裕春茶馆的捐税将以6240美元的租金为基础计算，而非4400美元。’”
